name: V25
description: Two-stage bone tumor screener: EfficientNet-B3 gate (300px) + EfficientNet-B6 specialist (456px), fine-tuned on the entity families the error anatomy flagged (ABC, bone island, chondroblastoma, CMF, BFH, chondrosarcoma, adamantinoma, chordoma, angiosarcoma, GCT, fibrous dysplasia, metastases) plus 38 harvested radiographs of the same diagnoses.

wild.note: 199 real-world radiographs (Radiology Assistant + bonetumor.org); V21 scored 98/199 on the identical protocol

independent.note: 50 radiographs from Wikimedia Commons, a THIRD source unseen by any model; V21 scored 11/50. 46 benign / 4 malignant, so it tests generalisation, not cancer recall.

selection_rule: malignant recall >= 80% of the 95 wild cancers, then max combined correct across the 564 benchmark + 199 wild + 50 third-source films
